title: 3.5 Ages 11-15
unit_outcome: Use tightly supported exchanges to greet people and give a name, age, origin and job, ask and answer yes/no questions with be, and describe who owns things.
goal: Recognize, hear and say eleven to fifteen, ask How old are you? and say how old a child is.
grammar_function: How old are you? / How old is he/she? He/She is + number + years old. What number is it? It is number...
prerequisite: 2.6-2.7 numbers 1-10 and What number is it?; 3.2-3.3 I am, he/she is.
speaking_outcome: Say eleven to fifteen, ask How old are you? and say a child's age.
